title: "Current State Map"

page-layout: full
format:

    code-copy: false

::: {.callout-note}
## Build and document the current flow

1. Start with the downstream process family selected in the Family Process Matrix and confirm the map boundary.
2. Paste a simple `Step A -> Step B` script to create a starting diagram, or work directly in the embedded Draw.io editor.
3. Select a process block in Draw.io, then enter or choose its matching label in the metadata panel. Save each observation to append it to the history.
4. Export all diagram formats and the metadata CSV. Your browser will prompt for downloads; save or move them into `output/`.
5. To define reusable fields, edit `supplement/custom-vsm-schema.json`, render the site again, and select **Custom JSON Schema**.
:::

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

viewof current_map_workspace = {
  const current_drawio_origin = "https://embed.diagrams.net";
  const current_empty_xml =
    '<mxfile host="embed.diagrams.net"><diagram id="current-state" name="Page-1"><mxGraphModel dx="1200" dy="800" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="1169" pageHeight="827"><root><mxCell id="0"/><mxCell id="1" parent="0"/></root></mxGraphModel></diagram></mxfile>';
  const current_templates = {
    basic: [
      {key: "description", label: "Description", type: "text"},
      {key: "owner", label: "Owner", type: "text"},
      {key: "handoff", label: "Next Handoff", type: "text"}
    ],
    standard: [
      {key: "cycle_time", label: "Cycle Time", type: "text"},
      {key: "changeover_time", label: "Changeover Time", type: "text"},
      {key: "uptime_oee", label: "Uptime / OEE (%)", type: "number"},
      {key: "scrap_defect_rate", label: "Scrap / Defect Rate (%)", type: "number"},
      {key: "batch_size", label: "Batch Size", type: "number"},
      {key: "operators", label: "Operators", type: "number"}
    ],
    software: [
      {key: "funding", label: "Funding", type: "text"},
      {key: "code_errors", label: "Code Errors", type: "text"},
      {key: "data_errors", label: "Data Errors", type: "text"},
      {key: "security_permissions", label: "Security / Permissions", type: "text"},
      {key: "approvals", label: "Approvals", type: "text"}
    ]
  };

  const current_state = {
    xml: current_empty_xml,
    history: [],
    history_fields: new Map(),
    fields: structuredClone(current_templates.basic),
    scripted_components: [],
    export_queue: []
  };

  const current_workspace = document.createElement("div");
  current_workspace.className = "current-map-workspace";

  const current_script_card = document.createElement("section");
  current_script_card.className = "current-map-card";
  const current_script_heading = document.createElement("h2");
  current_script_heading.textContent = "Option A: Create a diagram from text";
  const current_script_help = document.createElement("p");
  current_script_help.textContent =
    "Enter doc2draw-style process text. Put one step per line or connect labels with ->. The generated flow opens in the editor below.";
  const current_script = document.createElement("textarea");
  current_script.className = "current-script";
  current_script.setAttribute("aria-label", "Text-to-diagram process script");
  current_script.value =
    "Receive work -> Validate inputs -> Perform process -> Review output -> Deliver";
  const current_create_diagram = current_button("Create diagram from text");
  current_script_card.append(
    current_script_heading,
    current_script_help,
    current_script,
    current_create_diagram
  );

  const current_editor_card = document.createElement("section");
  current_editor_card.className = "current-map-card";
  const current_editor_heading = document.createElement("h2");
  current_editor_heading.textContent = "Option B: Edit directly in Draw.io";
  const current_editor_help = document.createElement("p");
  current_editor_help.textContent =
    "Use the full editor to add process blocks, decisions, queues, connectors, and annotations. Changes remain in this browser tab until exported.";
  const current_export_controls = document.createElement("div");
  current_export_controls.className = "current-map-controls";
  const current_export_all = current_button("Export all diagram formats");
  const current_export_help = document.createElement("span");
  current_export_help.textContent =
    "Downloads current_state.drawio, current_state.drawio.svg, and current_state.png. Place them in output/.";
  current_export_controls.append(current_export_all, current_export_help);
  const current_frame = document.createElement("iframe");
  current_frame.className = "current-drawio-frame";
  current_frame.title = "Draw.io Current State Map editor";
  current_frame.src =
    `${current_drawio_origin}/?embed=1&proto=json&spin=1&autosave=1&saveAndExit=0&noSaveBtn=1&libraries=1`;
  current_editor_card.append(
    current_editor_heading,
    current_editor_help,
    current_export_controls,
    current_frame
  );

  const current_metadata_card = document.createElement("section");
  current_metadata_card.className = "current-map-card";
  const current_metadata_details = document.createElement("details");
  current_metadata_details.className = "current-metadata-panel";
  const current_metadata_summary = document.createElement("summary");
  current_metadata_summary.textContent = "Process block metadata";
  const current_metadata_help = document.createElement("p");
  current_metadata_help.textContent =
    "Select a block in Draw.io, then use the same block label here. Choosing a saved component restores its most recent values.";

  const current_component_list = document.createElement("datalist");
  current_component_list.id = "current-component-options";
  const current_metadata_controls = document.createElement("div");
  current_metadata_controls.className = "current-map-controls";
  const current_component_label = document.createElement("label");
  current_component_label.textContent = "Selected process block";
  const current_component = document.createElement("input");
  current_component.type = "text";
  current_component.required = true;
  current_component.setAttribute("list", current_component_list.id);
  current_component.setAttribute("aria-label", "Selected process block");
  current_component_label.append(document.createElement("br"), current_component);

  const current_template_label = document.createElement("label");
  current_template_label.textContent = "Metadata template";
  const current_template = document.createElement("select");
  [
    ["basic", "Basic Flow"],
    ["standard", "Standard VSM Data Box"],
    ["software", "Software/Administrative VSM"],
    ["custom", "Custom JSON Schema"]
  ].forEach(([value, label]) => {
    const option = document.createElement("option");
    option.value = value;
    option.textContent = label;
    current_template.append(option);
  });
  current_template_label.append(document.createElement("br"), current_template);
  current_metadata_controls.append(
    current_component_label,
    current_template_label,
    current_component_list
  );

  const current_field_grid = document.createElement("div");
  current_field_grid.className = "current-field-grid";
  const current_add_controls = document.createElement("div");
  current_add_controls.className = "current-field-actions";
  const current_new_label = document.createElement("input");
  current_new_label.type = "text";
  current_new_label.placeholder = "Additional field label";
  current_new_label.setAttribute("aria-label", "Additional field label");
  const current_new_type = document.createElement("select");
  current_new_type.setAttribute("aria-label", "Additional field type");
  [["text", "Text"], ["number", "Number"], ["date", "Date"]].forEach(([value, label]) => {
    const option = document.createElement("option");
    option.value = value;
    option.textContent = label;
    current_new_type.append(option);
  });
  const current_add_field = current_button("Add field");
  current_add_controls.append(current_new_label, current_new_type, current_add_field);

  const current_record_controls = document.createElement("div");
  current_record_controls.className = "current-map-controls";
  const current_save_metadata = current_button("Append metadata record");
  const current_export_metadata = current_button("Export Metadata to CSV");
  current_record_controls.append(current_save_metadata, current_export_metadata);
  const current_history = document.createElement("code");
  current_history.className = "current-history";
  current_history.textContent = "No metadata records saved yet.";

  current_metadata_details.append(
    current_metadata_summary,
    current_metadata_help,
    current_metadata_controls,
    current_field_grid,
    current_add_controls,
    current_record_controls,
    current_history
  );
  current_metadata_card.append(current_metadata_details);

  const current_status = document.createElement("p");
  current_status.className = "current-status";
  current_status.setAttribute("role", "status");
  current_status.setAttribute("aria-live", "polite");
  current_workspace.append(
    current_script_card,
    current_editor_card,
    current_metadata_card,
    current_status
  );

  function current_button(label) {
    const element = document.createElement("button");
    element.type = "button";
    element.textContent = label;
    return element;
  }

  function current_notify(message) {
    current_status.textContent = message;
  }

  function current_post(message) {
    current_frame.contentWindow?.postMessage(
      JSON.stringify(message),
      current_drawio_origin
    );
  }

  function current_escape_xml(value) {
    return String(value)
      .replaceAll("&", "&amp;")
      .replaceAll("<", "&lt;")
      .replaceAll(">", "&gt;")
      .replaceAll('"', "&quot;")
      .replaceAll("'", "&apos;");
  }

  function current_parse_script(script) {
    const nodes = [];
    const edges = [];
    const node_index = new Map();
    const add_node = (label) => {
      const clean_label = label.trim();
      if (!clean_label) return null;
      if (!node_index.has(clean_label)) {
        node_index.set(clean_label, nodes.length);
        nodes.push(clean_label);
      }
      return node_index.get(clean_label);
    };

    script.split(/\r?\n/).map((line) => line.trim()).filter(Boolean).forEach((line) => {
      const labels = line.split(/\s*->\s*/).filter(Boolean);
      labels.forEach(add_node);
      for (let index = 0; index < labels.length - 1; index += 1) {
        edges.push([add_node(labels[index]), add_node(labels[index + 1])]);
      }
    });
    if (edges.length === 0) {
      for (let index = 0; index < nodes.length - 1; index += 1) {
        edges.push([index, index + 1]);
      }
    }
    return {nodes, edges};
  }

  function current_xml_from_script(script) {
    const parsed = current_parse_script(script);
    if (parsed.nodes.length === 0) {
      throw new Error("Enter at least one process step.");
    }
    const cells = parsed.nodes.map((label, index) => {
      const x = 60 + (index % 4) * 240;
      const y = 80 + Math.floor(index / 4) * 150;
      return `<mxCell id="node-${index}" value="${current_escape_xml(label)}" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="${x}" y="${y}" width="160" height="60" as="geometry"/></mxCell>`;
    });
    parsed.edges.forEach(([source, target], index) => {
      cells.push(`<mxCell id="edge-${index}" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;" edge="1" parent="1" source="node-${source}" target="node-${target}"><mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"/></mxCell>`);
    });
    current_state.scripted_components = parsed.nodes;
    current_component_list.replaceChildren(
      ...parsed.nodes.map((label) => {
        const option = document.createElement("option");
        option.value = label;
        return option;
      })
    );
    return `<mxfile host="embed.diagrams.net"><diagram id="current-state" name="Page-1"><mxGraphModel dx="1200" dy="800" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="1169" pageHeight="827"><root><mxCell id="0"/><mxCell id="1" parent="0"/>${cells.join("")}</root></mxGraphModel></diagram></mxfile>`;
  }

  function current_download_url(url, filename) {
    const link = document.createElement("a");
    link.href = url;
    link.download = filename;
    document.body.append(link);
    link.click();
    link.remove();
  }

  function current_download_blob(blob, filename) {
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    current_download_url(url, filename);
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  }

  function current_request_next_export() {
    const format = current_state.export_queue.shift();
    if (!format) {
      current_export_all.disabled = false;
      current_notify("All diagram downloads are ready. Save or move them into output/.");
      return;
    }
    current_state.active_export = format;
    current_post({
      action: "export",
      format,
      xml: current_state.xml,
      spinKey: "export"
    });
  }

  function current_handle_message(event) {
    if (
      event.origin !== current_drawio_origin ||
      event.source !== current_frame.contentWindow
    ) return;
    let message;
    try {
      message = typeof event.data === "string" ? JSON.parse(event.data) : event.data;
    } catch {
      return;
    }
    if (message.event === "init") {
      current_post({
        action: "load",
        autosave: 1,
        modified: "unsavedChanges",
        xml: current_state.xml,
        title: "Current State Map"
      });
      current_notify("Draw.io editor ready.");
    } else if (message.event === "autosave" || message.event === "save") {
      if (message.xml) current_state.xml = message.xml;
    } else if (message.event === "export" && message.data) {
      const filename =
        current_state.active_export === "xmlsvg"
          ? "current_state.drawio.svg"
          : "current_state.png";
      current_download_url(message.data, filename);
      current_request_next_export();
    }
  }
  window.addEventListener("message", current_handle_message);

  current_create_diagram.addEventListener("click", () => {
    try {
      current_state.xml = current_xml_from_script(current_script.value);
      current_post({
        action: "load",
        autosave: 1,
        modified: "unsavedChanges",
        xml: current_state.xml,
        title: "Current State Map"
      });
      current_notify("Created a starting diagram from the process script.");
    } catch (error) {
      current_notify(error.message);
    }
  });

  current_export_all.addEventListener("click", () => {
    current_export_all.disabled = true;
    current_download_blob(
      new Blob([current_state.xml], {type: "application/xml;charset=utf-8"}),
      "current_state.drawio"
    );
    current_state.export_queue = ["xmlsvg", "xmlpng"];
    current_notify("Preparing editable SVG and PNG exports…");
    current_request_next_export();
  });

  function current_key(label) {
    return label
      .trim()
      .toLowerCase()
      .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "_")
      .replace(/^_+|_+$/g, "");
  }

  function current_latest_record(component) {
    return [...current_state.history].reverse().find(
      (record) => record.component === component
    );
  }

  function current_render_fields(values = {}) {
    current_field_grid.replaceChildren();
    current_state.fields.forEach((field, index) => {
      const row = document.createElement("div");
      row.className = "current-field-row";
      const label = document.createElement("label");
      label.textContent = field.label;
      const input = document.createElement("input");
      input.type = ["text", "number", "date"].includes(field.type)
        ? field.type
        : "text";
      input.value = values[field.key] ?? "";
      input.dataset.fieldKey = field.key;
      label.append(input);
      const remove = current_button(`Remove ${field.label}`);
      remove.addEventListener("click", () => {
        current_state.fields.splice(index, 1);
        current_render_fields(current_field_values());
      });
      row.append(label, remove);
      current_field_grid.append(row);
    });
  }

  function current_field_values() {
    return Object.fromEntries(
      [...current_field_grid.querySelectorAll("[data-field-key]")].map((input) => [
        input.dataset.fieldKey,
        input.value
      ])
    );
  }

  async function current_set_template(template_name, values = {}) {
    if (template_name === "custom") {
      try {
        const response = await fetch("./supplement/custom-vsm-schema.json");
        if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${response.status}`);
        const schema = await response.json();
        if (!Array.isArray(schema.fields)) throw new Error("Missing fields array");
        current_state.fields = schema.fields
          .filter((field) => field && typeof field.label === "string")
          .map((field) => ({
            key: current_key(field.key || field.label),
            label: field.label,
            type: ["text", "number", "date"].includes(field.type)
              ? field.type
              : "text"
          }))
          .filter((field) => field.key);
        current_notify(`Loaded ${schema.title || "custom metadata schema"}.`);
      } catch {
        current_state.fields = [];
        current_notify(
          "Could not load supplement/custom-vsm-schema.json. Check the schema and render the site again."
        );
      }
    } else {
      current_state.fields = structuredClone(current_templates[template_name]);
    }
    current_render_fields(values);
  }

  async function current_restore_component() {
    const component = current_component.value.trim();
    if (!component) return;
    current_metadata_details.open = true;
    const latest = current_latest_record(component);
    if (!latest) {
      await current_set_template(current_template.value);
      return;
    }
    current_template.value = latest.template;
    current_state.fields = structuredClone(
      current_state.history_fields.get(latest.timestamp) ||
      current_templates[latest.template] ||
      []
    );
    current_render_fields(latest);
    current_notify(`Restored the latest metadata for ${component}.`);
  }

  current_component.addEventListener("change", current_restore_component);
  current_template.addEventListener("change", () => {
    current_set_template(current_template.value);
  });

  current_add_field.addEventListener("click", () => {
    const label = current_new_label.value.trim();
    const key = current_key(label);
    if (!key) {
      current_notify("Enter a label for the additional field.");
      return;
    }
    if (current_state.fields.some((field) => field.key === key)) {
      current_notify("That field already exists.");
      return;
    }
    const values = current_field_values();
    current_state.fields.push({key, label, type: current_new_type.value});
    current_new_label.value = "";
    current_render_fields(values);
    current_notify(`Added ${label}.`);
  });

  function current_render_history() {
    if (current_state.history.length === 0) {
      current_history.textContent = "No metadata records saved yet.";
      return;
    }
    current_history.textContent = current_state.history
      .map((record) => `${record.timestamp} — ${record.component} (${record.template})`)
      .join("\n");
  }

  current_save_metadata.addEventListener("click", () => {
    const component = current_component.value.trim();
    if (!component) {
      current_notify("Enter the selected process block before saving metadata.");
      current_component.focus();
      return;
    }
    const timestamp = new Date().toISOString();
    const record = {
      timestamp,
      component,
      template: current_template.value,
      ...current_field_values()
    };
    current_state.history.push(record);
    current_state.history_fields.set(timestamp, structuredClone(current_state.fields));
    current_render_history();
    current_workspace.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", {bubbles: true}));
    current_notify(`Appended metadata for ${component}.`);
  });

  function current_csv_value(value) {
    return `"${String(value ?? "").replaceAll('"', '""')}"`;
  }

  current_export_metadata.addEventListener("click", () => {
    if (current_state.history.length === 0) {
      current_notify("Save at least one metadata record before exporting.");
      return;
    }
    const columns = [
      "timestamp",
      "component",
      "template",
      ...new Set(current_state.history.flatMap((record) => Object.keys(record)))
    ].filter((value, index, values) => values.indexOf(value) === index);
    const lines = [
      columns.map(current_csv_value).join(","),
      ...current_state.history.map((record) =>
        columns.map((column) => current_csv_value(record[column])).join(",")
      )
    ];
    current_download_blob(
      new Blob([lines.join("\r\n")], {type: "text/csv;charset=utf-8"}),
      "current_state_metadata.csv"
    );
    current_notify("Metadata history CSV ready. Save or move it into output/.");
  });

  Object.defineProperty(current_workspace, "value", {
    get: () => ({
      xml: current_state.xml,
      history: structuredClone(current_state.history)
    })
  });

  current_render_fields();
  return current_workspace;
}
```
